metric_definitions.cold_us: first textDocument/codeLens round trip for the file, measured by the client
metric_definitions.warm_us: second round trip for the same file, immediately after the first
metric_definitions.lenses: number of items in the warm answer
metric_definitions.lenses_past_eof: lenses whose zero-based start line is at or past the number of lines in the file
metric_definitions.lens_names_missing: distinct lens names that do not occur in the file text
metric_definitions.digest: sha256 of the warm answer serialised with sorted keys and no whitespace
metric_definitions.answers.pairs: per pair of binaries, files with a different warm digest in any round; for each, the lens multisets of the first round compared (removed, added, b_subset_of_a)
metric_definitions.slowest_warm: the 10 files with the highest warm_us in the run
